title: Pause rebalancing in storms; add the refund_auto_approve flag
author: ren.okafor
body:
## Change

- Rebalancing now holds off any time the latest Skyglass reading comes back at severity 3 or above.
- Behind a new refund_auto_approve flag, a refund under $5.00 clears without anyone reviewing it.
- feature_flags picks up a fourth row for the new flag, alongside dynamic_pricing, ebike_surcharge and overflow_parking.

Links GW-170 and GW-171.

## Testing

New storm-pause unit tests and the refund e2e case for the auto-approve path both pass.

comments.author: tobin.achebe
comments.body: Why severity 3 specifically: that's the exact level ops was already calling vans back at by hand, before this pause existed to do it for us. This just codifies what the team was doing manually.

comments.author: kasia.brandt
comments.body: Reviewed the refund half -- couple of naming nits, nothing blocking.

comments.author: mara.voss
comments.body: Refund half looks good to me, approving that side.

comments.author: tobin.achebe
comments.body: One more note for the record: as of PR 19, ops is taking over ownership of the Skyglass integration from fleet, since ops is the team actually acting on the severity reading day to day now.
